verdict.rationale: Polar ships its own remote MCP server, with OAuth and documented setup for Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT and Claude Desktop. Through it, AI agents can look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions and orders, so users can operate Polar in natural language through a connected AI client. There is no built-in natural-language interface in Polar itself, so this depends on an external agent. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which actions are exposed as MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Agents can look up data and take actions across your products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits, and more.
Use Polar's remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to give AI agents secure access to your Polar organization.
